def process_in_order(tasks: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Return the tasks uppercased, in arrival order. The queue can hold a million tasks."""
    queue = list(tasks)
    done = []
    while queue:
        done.append(queue.pop(0).upper())
    return done

expected_issues.note: pop(0) on a list is O(n), so the loop is O(n^2) for a million tasks.

import re

_NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Turn a title into a URL slug, such as "Hello, World!" into "hello-world".

    Args:
        title: The text to convert.

    Returns:
        The lowercase ASCII letters and digits of the title, in runs joined
        by single hyphens. Any other character, including accented letters,
        separates runs.
    """
    return _NON_WORD.sub("-", title.lower()).strip("-")

from collections.abc import Sequence


def chunked[T](items: Sequence[T], size: int) -> list[Sequence[T]]:
    """Split items into consecutive chunks of at most size items.

    Args:
        items: The items to split.
        size: The largest chunk size; the last chunk may be smaller.

    Returns:
        The chunks in order, or an empty list if items is empty.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If size is less than 1.
    """
    if size < 1:
        raise ValueError("size must be at least 1")
    return [items[start : start + size] for start in range(0, len(items), size)]

from collections import Counter


def top_words(text: str, n: int = 3) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the n most common words in text, most common first.

    Words are split on whitespace and compared case-insensitively;
    punctuation stays attached to its word. Ties keep the order in which
    the words first appear.

    Args:
        text: The text to count.
        n: How many words to return.

    Returns:
        (word, count) pairs, with words in lowercase.
    """
    return Counter(text.lower().split()).most_common(n)

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def load_settings(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read a JSON settings file whose top level is an object.

    Args:
        path: The settings file.

    Returns:
        The settings, keyed by name.

    Raises:
        FileNotFoundError: If the file doesn't exist.
        json.JSONDecodeError: If the file isn't valid JSON.
        ValueError: If the top level isn't a JSON object.
    """
    settings = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(settings, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{path} must contain a JSON object")
    return settings

from bisect import bisect_left


def find_index(sorted_items: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    """Return the index of target in a list sorted in ascending order, or -1 if absent.

    Uses binary search, so it takes O(log n) time. If target appears more
    than once, the first index is returned.
    """
    index = bisect_left(sorted_items, target)
    if index < len(sorted_items) and sorted_items[index] == target:
        return index
    return -1

from pathlib import Path

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("/srv/uploads").resolve()


def read_upload(name: str) -> bytes:
    """Return the contents of an uploaded file.

    Args:
        name: The file's name inside the upload folder.

    Returns:
        The file's bytes.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If name points outside the upload folder.
        FileNotFoundError: If there is no such file.
    """
    path = (UPLOAD_DIR / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(UPLOAD_DIR):
        raise ValueError(f"{name!r} is outside the upload folder")
    return path.read_bytes()
